definition: a turning disc that pushes a part up and down
description: In the machine room inside an old bell tower, a large shiny brass disc with an egg-shaped outline turns on an axle between big gears and chains, and a vertical metal rod beneath it moves up and down. Pigeons fly off through beams of sunlight and feathers drift down. On the wooden workbench below, smaller brass discs of the same kind sit on a shaft next to oil cans. Through the slatted shutters a bronze bell hangs in front of a view of city rooftops.

taps.phrase: to rotate on a metal shaft
to fly off through the sunbeams
